postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned ELTA lookup receipt or permitted operator snapshot establishes a five-digit assignment at its capture time. NNN NN syntax, a locality, street, serving office, island route, GISCO point, or structurally valid digits do not establish current allocation or deliverability.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: No reviewed public source currently establishes reusable ELTA postcode perimeters. GISCO postal-code points, NUTS or LAU units, ELSTAT census geography, municipalities, settlements, islands, buffers and Voronoi cells are not ELTA polygons. Rights-cleared address-membership surfaces are explicitly derived and uncertainty-bearing.
postal_system.address_rule: Exact address display requires a permitted ELTA assertion or a pinned official municipal or national street-number identifier with hierarchy, locator, postcode, validity, capture time, product-specific rights and digest. A project page, search availability, road axis, parcel or census feature is not a live nationwide address record.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit distributable address-to-building relationship, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed crosswalk. ELSTAT outlines, cadastral parcels, census blocks, containment and proximity remain distinct and candidate-only.
postal_system.service_status_rule: ELTA office operation, island or remote routing, delivery status and API/search availability are time-stamped operational evidence separate from assignment, geometry, country identity and historical validity.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Regions, regional units, municipalities, municipal units, communities, settlements, islands, Mount Athos status and census geography remain separately sourced context. They do not create postcode membership, delivery eligibility or an ELTA perimeter.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment, street or locality match, address, building, point, derived surface, administrative context and operational service validity when supplied.
temporal_model.known_time: Publication, lookup capture, ingest, correction, terms review, coverage review and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: New ELTA, GISCO, Cadastre, ELSTAT or municipal snapshots append versioned assertions; no refresh rewrites older evidence, promotes a census layer to a current postal perimeter or converts a planned register into live address data.

quality_gates.pass: Each full code references a pinned ELTA receipt or permitted snapshot with five-digit text, query/result scope, capture time, terms and digest.
Every geometry declares operator-official, official-derived point or derived authority; point-derived surfaces retain algorithm, uncertainty, exclusions, validity and lineage.
Each exact address retains a source identifier, hierarchy, permitted fields, coverage, validity, capture time, rights and ELTA cross-check.
An exact building has an explicit distributable relationship, common identifier or reviewed crosswalk; parcel, block, outline, containment and proximity are never silently substituted.
Every ELTA, GISCO, Cadastre, ELSTAT, municipality, portal or register artifact pins exact terms, attribution, schema, coverage, vintage, CRS and digest.
Mainland, islands, remote routes, Mount Athos and administrative boundaries are separately sourced and never inferred from a postal code or delivery route.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, occupant, title or cadastral record, phone, credential or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, address/building identifiers, geometry semantics, coverage and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, license, freshness, coverage and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
